source._comment: Iowa SoS 'Absentee Ballot Statistics' PDF. Hierarchical: a county line (name + Requested Issued Received), then per-party lines (Democrat/Republican/No Party/Libertarian/Other + Req Issued Received), then receipt-method sub-lines. We take each party's RECEIVED (returned) as ballots cast; a county's Received equals the sum of its parties' Received. Iowa early voting IS absentee (in-person at the office/satellite + mail), so this is the whole early-vote electorate by party. No registration totals in the file -> no turnout%. The 2026 file publishes under /elections/pdf/2026/general/; validation_url is the persisted 2024 file used by --validate. Requires pypdf (IA workflow step installs it).
